summary: Brookfield Renewable Corp (BEPC) filed a 6-K on July 28, 2026, attaching an Arrangement Agreement dated July 21, 2026 among BEP Inc., Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. (BEP), and BEPC. The agreement outlines a plan to consolidate the ownership structure, with BEP unitholders and BEPC shareholders receiving consideration to hold their investments through BEP Inc., a newly formed corporation. Scotia Capital issued fairness opinions. The arrangement requires court interim order, security holder meetings, and regulatory approvals. Specified price per share, premium, and expected close date are not disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction appears to be a going-private or internal reorganization, likely aimed at simplifying the corporate structure.
